definition.description: Shared compression principles: one concept or method per bilingual row, reused by object-specific research topics. Persistent reference content.

row.body_en:
Temperature T adjusts classification probabilities; soft targets convey relationships between classes and can be combined with labels. Regression-oriented domain models need appropriate output or feature objectives.
Student design determines potential resource cost, while evaluation establishes retained capability. Distillation may be combined with quantization, but the combination needs separate measurement.
row.body_zh:
温度 T 用于调节分类概率分布，软目标提供类别间的信息；真实标签可与教师目标共同训练。回归式领域模型则应选择适合任务的输出或特征目标。
学生结构决定潜在资源开销，训练与测试决定能力是否保留。蒸馏可以再与量化结合，但组合后的质量与速度仍要独立测量。
row.evidence_locator: Section 2; temperature, soft targets and combined objectives
row.source_title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
row.summary_en: A stronger teacher does not guarantee equivalent student quality.
row.summary_zh: 教师更强，不保证学生在所有任务上都接近教师。
row.title_en: Compression comes from student design and learned transfer
row.title_zh: 压缩来自学生设计，能力来自训练迁移

row.body_en:
A teacher supplies training signals such as probability distributions. A student learns these signals together with the task objective; compression commonly uses a smaller student deployed on its own.
Distillation does not prescribe parameter count or bit width. Architecture, data and loss must be chosen explicitly. The equation illustrates classification soft-target distillation; domain models may require different objectives.
T>0 is the temperature, α∈[0,1] weights the task loss L_task, and CE compares teacher and student soft probability distributions.
row.body_zh:
教师模型提供概率分布等训练信号，学生模型学习这些输出及任务目标。模型压缩场景通常选择更小的学生，在部署时只运行学生。
蒸馏不会自动规定学生的参数量或位宽。需要分别选择学生结构、训练数据和损失；效果取决于学生能否保留任务所需能力。下式仅示意分类任务的软目标蒸馏，领域模型可能需要其他目标。
T>0 是温度，α∈[0,1] 控制任务损失的权重，L_task 表示任务损失；CE 比较教师和学生的软概率分布。
row.evidence_locator: Section 2; temperature, soft targets and combined objectives
row.formula: p_T = softmax(logits / T);  L = αL_task + (1−α)T² CE(p_teacher,T, p_student,T)
row.source_title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
row.summary_en: Transfer behavior, often to a smaller model.
row.summary_zh: 改变模型获得能力的方式，通常用于训练更小的模型。
row.title_en: Knowledge distillation: train a student from a teacher
row.title_zh: 知识蒸馏：让学生模型学习教师行为

row.body_en:
Approximate an m×n matrix W by A of size m×r and B of size r×n. Compute A(Bx); rank r controls capacity and approximation error.
Parameter count falls only when r(m+n)<mn. Runtime also depends on two matrix multiplications, an intermediate tensor and kernel efficiency. Select rank using output reconstruction or task quality.
row.body_zh:
将 m×n 的矩阵 W 近似为 m×r 的 A 与 r×n 的 B。计算由 W x 改为 A(Bx)，中间维度 r 控制压缩程度与表达能力。
只有 r(m+n) 小于 mn，参数数量才减少；实际速度还受两次矩阵乘、中间张量与算子效率影响。秩过低会丢失重要信息，需用任务质量或输出重构误差选择 r。
row.formula: W ≈ AB;  mn → r(m+n);  y ≈ A(Bx)
row.source_title: SVD-LLM: Truncation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
row.summary_en: Replace a matrix by a lower-rank representation.
row.summary_zh: 改变矩阵的表示结构，以较低的秩保留主要信息。
row.title_en: Low-rank factorization: approximate a matrix with smaller factors
row.title_zh: 低秩分解：用较小矩阵近似大矩阵

row.body_en:
Pruning removes selected parameters or structures, sometimes followed by quality recovery. Zeroing individual weights and removing entire rows, columns or layers create different execution patterns.
Unstructured pruning needs sparse storage and kernels to exploit zeros. Structured pruning can produce smaller dense operations but requires consistent changes to adjacent layers. Zeros alone do not accelerate an unchanged dense kernel.
M is a binary keep mask: 1 retains an entry and 0 removes it; ⊙ denotes elementwise multiplication.
row.body_zh:
剪枝按某种重要性准则移除部分参数或结构，并在需要时恢复质量。对单个权重置零与删除整行、整列或整层，产生的执行形式并不相同。
非结构化剪枝需要能够跳过零值的稀疏表示和算子；结构化剪枝可产生更小的稠密计算，但需要正确调整相邻层。只增加零值、仍执行原来的稠密运算，不保证更快。
公式中的 M 是保留掩码：1 表示保留，0 表示移除；⊙ 表示对应位置相乘。
row.evidence_locator: Sections 2.3 and 3.1; model/ephemeral sparsity and structured pruning
row.source_title: Sparsity in Deep Learning: Pruning and growth for efficient inference and training in neural networks
row.summary_en: Choose which connections, channels, attention heads or other structures remain.
row.summary_zh: 改变保留哪些连接、通道、注意力头或其他结构。
row.title_zh: 剪枝：删除部分参数或结构

row.body_en:
Quantization usually preserves tensor shape and element count while changing how each value is encoded. Sharing fewer representation levels introduces approximation error.
Fewer bits can reduce storage and memory traffic. Inference gains require compatible formats, kernels and workloads. The examples below use uniform affine integer quantization; low-precision floating point and vector codebooks use other rules.
In the formula, x is the original value, q the integer code, s the step size, z the code representing zero, and x̂ the reconstructed approximation.
row.body_zh:
量化通常保留张量的形状和元素数量，改变的是每个元素如何编码。更多数值共用较少的表示等级，因而可能产生误差。
减少位数可以降低存储量和读取流量；只有格式、算子与实际负载匹配时，才可能进一步改善推理性能。下面用均匀整数仿射量化入门；低精度浮点和向量码本还使用不同的表示规则。
公式中，x 是原数值，q 是整数编码，s 是刻度间隔，z 是零值对应的编码，x̂ 是重建后的近似值。
row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.formula: q = clip(round(x / s) + z, q_min, q_max);  x̂ = s(q − z)
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.summary_en: Change numerical representation by approximating values with fewer levels.
row.summary_zh: 改变数值表示，用有限等级近似原来的数值。
row.title_zh: 量化：减少每个数的表示位数

row.body_en:
Quantization uses fewer bits per value; pruning removes parameters or structures; low-rank factorization approximates a large matrix with smaller factors; knowledge distillation transfers a teacher’s behavior to a student. Each reduces resource use differently and introduces approximation error or training cost.
Weights, activations and KV cache are compression targets. Applying the same method to different targets raises different distribution, lifetime and execution questions, addressed in their research topics. These four common approaches can be combined; map cells do not imply equal maturity.
row.body_zh:
量化减少每个数的表示位数，剪枝移除部分参数或结构，低秩分解用较小矩阵近似大矩阵，知识蒸馏让学生模型学习教师的行为。它们减少资源开销的方式不同，也各自引入误差或训练成本。
权重、激活和 KV Cache 是压缩对象。相同方法用于不同对象时，面临的分布、生命周期和执行条件不同，因此需要进入相应专题研究。这四类方法是常用的组织方式，可以组合使用；技术地图中的交叉点不意味着每种组合都同样成熟。
row.source_title: A Survey on Model Compression for Large Language Models
row.summary_en: Understand four common approaches through numerical representation, parameter structure, matrix rank and knowledge transfer.
row.summary_zh: 从数值表示、参数结构、矩阵秩和知识迁移，理解四类常见压缩方法。
row.title_en: What changes when a model is compressed?
row.title_zh: 压缩模型，主要改变什么

row.body_en:
A 4-bit code has 16 possible patterns and a 2-bit code has four. Quantization maps values to a finite set of levels and stores short codes. Rounding decimals while retaining FP16 storage does not save representation bits.
Follow four weights [−0.875, −0.625, 0.125, 0.375]. Their count remains four. Two bits are used to make every code visible, not as a deployment recommendation.
row.body_zh:
一个 4-bit 编码有 16 种可能，一个 2-bit 编码有 4 种可能。量化将原来的数值映射到有限等级，并保存较短的编码；只把小数四舍五入后仍用 FP16 保存，并不会节省表示位数。
以下用四个权重 [−0.875, −0.625, 0.125, 0.375] 演示。它们仍是四个权重，改变的是每个数的表示方式。2-bit 仅用于把四种编码画清楚，不是对业务模型的位宽推荐。
row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.formula: 2^b codes;  weight payload = N × b / 8 bytes
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.summary_zh: 先区分数值、编码和存储空间。
row.title_zh: 01 · 少用位数，究竟省了什么

row.body_en:
Divide by scale, round, add the zero point and clamp to valid codes. The four values yield [0, 1, 2, 3], or 00, 01, 10, 11. Reconstruction gives [−1, −0.5, 0, 0.5].
Four FP16 representations occupy 64 bits; four 2-bit codes occupy eight bits, excluding shared parameters. This illustrates encoding, not an observed whole-model compression ratio or speedup.
row.body_zh:
先除以步长、取整、加零点，再限制到合法编码范围。上述四个数得到编码 [0, 1, 2, 3]，可写为 00、01、10、11；用同一映射重建后为 [−1, −0.5, 0, 0.5]。
四个 FP16 表示共 64 bit，四个 2-bit 编码共 8 bit；尺度和零点还要另外存储。这个算例展示编码如何节省位数，不能当成完整模型压缩率或性能实测。
row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.summary_zh: 保存的是编码，恢复的是近似值。
row.title_zh: 03 · 从数值到编码，再恢复近似值

row.body_en:
Rounding assigns in-range values to nearby levels. Clipping clamps values outside the representable range. Nearest rounding without clipping has error magnitude at most s/2.
A few large values can widen a shared range and coarsen levels for ordinary values. Clipping them can remove important information. Calibration, grouping, scaling and compensation address this trade-off. Numerical error is not task-quality loss.
row.body_zh:
范围内的数值被映射到附近刻度，产生舍入误差；超出可表示范围的数值被限制到边界，产生裁剪误差。最近舍入且不发生裁剪时，误差幅值不超过 s/2。
少数大值可能拉宽共享范围，让多数普通值使用更粗的刻度。直接裁掉它们又可能损害重要信息。需要通过校准、分组、缩放或误差补偿控制影响；数值误差不等同于业务精度损失。
row.evidence_locator: Sections 2–4; quantization parameters, PTQ and QAT
row.source_title: A White Paper on Neural Network Quantization
row.summary_en: At fixed bit width, coverage competes with resolution.
row.summary_zh: 同样的位数，需要在覆盖范围与刻度精细度之间取舍。
row.title_zh: 04 · 区分舍入误差和裁剪误差

row.body_en:
W4A16 specifies 4-bit weight representation and 16-bit activations, not INT4 for every operation. A runtime may fuse unpacking and dequantization with computation instead of expanding the entire tensor.
W8A8 constrains weight and activation precision; accumulators and other operators may differ. Evaluate memory traffic, conversion and kernels separately for decode and prefill workloads.
row.body_zh:
W4A16 表示权重使用 4-bit 表示、激活使用 16-bit；不表示所有乘加都以 INT4 完成。运行时可在计算中融合解包和反量化，避免先展开整份权重。
W8A8 同时约束权重和激活位宽，但累加器、归一化等环节仍可能使用其他精度。压缩收益取决于读取量、格式转换和计算核；小批量解码与大批量预填充应分别评估。
row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–5; layer reconstruction and execution constraints
row.formula: W4A16: W=4 bit, A=16 bit;  W8A8: W=8 bit, A=8 bit
row.source_title: GPTQ: Accurate Post-Training Quantization for Generative Pre-trained Transformers
row.summary_en: Storage savings and latency gains require separate checks.
row.summary_zh: 省存储与省时延是两个需要分别验证的结果。
row.title_en: 06 · Turn compact representation into inference gains
row.title_zh: 06 · 从紧凑表示到实际推理

row.body_en:
Per-tensor quantization shares parameters across a tensor; per-channel uses a specified channel axis; per-group partitions along an explicit dimension. A common weight layout groups input-feature values within each output channel. State the axis, not merely the group size.
Finer groups can reduce local error while adding scales, zero points and possible layout changes. Compare quality, actual storage and kernel compatibility together.
row.body_zh:
逐张量量化让整个张量共享参数；逐通道量化按指定通道分别设置；逐组量化则按明确的维度划分小块。在常见权重矩阵布局中，可以在每个输出通道内沿输入维度分组，不能只说“每组”而不标轴向。
更细分组有机会降低局部误差，也需要更多尺度、零点和可能的数据重排。应与模型质量、实际存储量及内核支持一起比较。
row.evidence_locator: Sections 3–4; activation-aware scaling and TinyChat execution
row.formula: W ∈ ℝ^(out×in);  group within each output channel along in
row.source_title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
row.summary_en: Granularity defines which values share parameters.
row.summary_zh: 粒度回答哪些数共用一组量化参数。
row.title_en: 05 · Use separate scales for different distributions
row.title_zh: 05 · 让不同分布使用不同的刻度

row.body_en:
PTQ starts from a trained model and may use representative data for calibration, parameter search or local reconstruction. QAT simulates quantization during training or fine-tuning.
Static and dynamic usually refer to when activation quantization parameters are obtained: ahead of execution or from runtime inputs. They are distinct from PTQ/QAT and do not imply a universal speed or accuracy ordering.
row.body_zh:
训练后量化（PTQ）从已有模型开始，可能使用代表样本做校准、参数搜索或局部重构。量化感知训练（QAT）在训练或微调中模拟量化影响，使参数适应低精度。
静态与动态通常讨论激活量化参数的确定时机：静态提前校准，动态在运行时根据当前输入计算。它们不等同于 PTQ/QAT，也不能简单认定一种必然更快或更准。
row.evidence_locator: Sections 2–4; quantization parameters, PTQ and QAT
row.source_title: A White Paper on Neural Network Quantization
row.summary_en: PTQ/QAT and static/dynamic describe different choices.
row.summary_zh: PTQ、QAT与静态、动态分别回答不同问题。
row.title_zh: 模型怎样得到量化参数

row.body_en:
The example permits reconstructed values −1, −0.5, 0 and 0.5, assigned codes 0, 1, 2 and 3. Adjacent levels differ by 0.5, so s=0.5. Real zero uses code 2, so z=2.
Codes are not original values. Nonnegative codes can represent negative numbers through this shared mapping. Real parameters are selected from tensor distributions and error objectives.
row.body_zh:
示例允许四个重建值：−1、−0.5、0、0.5，分别对应整数编码 0、1、2、3。相邻数值相差 0.5，所以 s=0.5；实数 0 对应编码 2，所以 z=2。
编码不是原始数值。非负整数编码也能表示负数，因为读取时使用共享的映射。实际量化参数需根据张量分布与误差目标确定。
row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.summary_en: Scale sets level spacing; zero point identifies real zero.
row.summary_zh: 步长决定相邻等级间距，零点决定哪个编码代表零。
row.title_en: 02 · Define the scale and zero point
row.title_zh: 02 · 用步长和零点规定刻度

row.body_en:
Signed symmetric quantization commonly uses zero point 0. Asymmetric affine quantization uses an integer offset to fit a shifted range, subject to implementation support.
The signed INT8 range −128 to 127 is not symmetric at its endpoints. Specify code bounds, scale and rounding convention.
row.body_zh:
有符号对称量化通常让零点为 0；仿射非对称量化允许用整数零点平移范围。范围不对称时，后者可更充分地使用编码，但要核对相应计算支持。
不要把 INT8 的 −128 到 127 写成两端严格对称。教学和实现都应写清实际采用的整数范围、步长和舍入规则。
row.evidence_locator: Section 2.1–2.4; affine mapping and integer arithmetic
row.source_title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
row.summary_en: Symmetry and grouping are independent settings.
row.summary_zh: 对称性与分组粒度是两项独立配置。
row.title_zh: 范围是否对称，零点如何选择

row.body_en:
Truncated SVD retains selected singular directions. For model compression, preserving outputs under real inputs matters as well as matrix approximation.
For a 512×512 matrix with rank 64, parameter count falls from 262,144 to 65,536, a 75% reduction. This arithmetic example does not establish a 75% memory or latency reduction; intermediates and both computations must be measured.
row.body_zh:
截断 SVD 保留部分奇异方向，能控制矩阵近似误差；模型中更重要的问题是近似后是否保持实际输入下的输出。只按权重矩阵误差选秩，可能与业务目标不一致。
以 512×512 矩阵、r=64 为算例，参数由262,144变为65,536，减少75%。这是公式推导的参数数量，不是实际显存或时延下降75%；还需测量中间张量和两段计算。
row.source_title: SVD-LLM: Truncation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
row.summary_en: Select rank from task quality, not matrix size alone.
row.summary_zh: 按任务效果选秩，而不是只看矩阵大小。
row.title_en: Lower rank trades representation capacity for compression
row.title_zh: 秩越小，压缩越强，信息损失也可能越大

row.body_en:
Weight quantization examines input-weighted error and format/kernel compatibility; activation quantization examines changing distributions and outliers; KV-cache quantization examines layouts, attention error and read costs.
Select a map cell for topic-specific research. Current updates record new evidence and the insight report synthesizes it; this foundation page keeps stable principles separate from monthly conclusions.
row.body_zh:
权重量化要关注输入如何放大权重误差，以及导出格式与矩阵核是否匹配；激活量化要关注输入变化与离群值；KV Cache 量化要关注缓存布局、注意力误差及读取开销。
在技术地图选择对象与方法后，再比较对应专题中的算法机制和原文结果。本期动态负责记录新证据，洞察报告负责形成综合判断，不在基础页混入月度结论。
row.source_title: A Survey on Model Compression for Large Language Models
row.summary_en: The same method faces different constraints on different targets.
row.summary_zh: 同一方法作用于不同对象，挑战与实现也会变化。
row.title_en: From shared principles to targeted research
row.title_zh: 从共用原理进入具体研究

row.body_en:
The introductory article informs the progression from resource needs and numerical representation to errors and design choices. This page uses original explanations; the article is further reading, not evidence for device support or performance.
Equations and mechanisms are grounded in the cited primary literature. Algorithm details and business validation belong to the linked research topics.
row.body_zh:
本页吸收该入门文章从资源需求、数值表示到误差与方案选择的讲解顺序，并以原创表述组织。它作为延伸阅读，不作为设备支持或性能数字的证明。
公式与方法分别对照量化、稀疏、蒸馏和低秩分解的原始文献；涉及具体算法和业务验证时，继续进入相应研究专题。
row.evidence_locator: Chapters 1–5; explanatory sequence only; technical statements checked against primary literature
row.source_title: 为大模型“瘦身”：一文读懂模型量化的核心原理与挑战（入门篇）
row.summary_en: Use the introductory sequence while grounding mechanisms in primary literature.
row.summary_zh: 借鉴入门文章的递进方式，技术机制以原论文为依据。

row.body_en:
Unstructured sparsity retains irregular locations and needs indices. An N:M pattern generally permits at most N nonzero values in each group of M positions, subject to the format’s axis and grouping rules. Structured pruning may instead yield smaller dense operators.
Include indexing, scheduling, imbalance and quality-recovery costs. Sparse-pattern support on one device does not establish support on another.
row.body_zh:
非结构化稀疏保留不规则位置，需额外记录索引。N:M 模式通常要求每 M 个位置至多保留 N 个非零值，具体以格式约定为准；还需明确轴向和分组。结构化剪枝则删除整块结构，可能形成更小的稠密算子。
实际收益必须包含索引读取、调度、负载不均衡和质量恢复成本。不同设备支持的稀疏模式不可互相推定。
row.evidence_locator: Sections 2.3 and 3.1; model/ephemeral sparsity and structured pruning
row.source_title: Sparsity in Deep Learning: Pruning and growth for efficient inference and training in neural networks
row.summary_en: The retained pattern must match execution.
row.summary_zh: 要看保留模式与实际执行形式。
row.title_en: More zeros do not imply proportional speedups
row.title_zh: 零值增多，不代表耗时同比下降

row.body_en:
Sparsity describes tensors with relatively few nonzero elements or computation using selected connections. Pruning removes parameters or structures; input-dependent activation selection can also create sparsity.
These are not disjoint categories. Identify the sparse object, whether the pattern is fixed or dynamic, and how execution skips unused work.
The formula measures element sparsity. Structured pruning can leave a smaller dense matrix, whose parameter count and computation should be compared separately.
row.body_zh:
稀疏描述张量中只有部分元素非零，或一次执行只使用部分连接。剪枝通过删除参数或结构形成稀疏性，但动态激活选择也能产生随输入变化的稀疏性。
因此技术地图不把两者视为完全互斥的平行类别。阅读具体方案时，需要说明稀疏对象、模式是固定还是动态，以及运行时怎样跳过未使用的部分。
下式衡量元素稀疏率；结构化剪枝后的矩阵可能更小但仍然稠密，应另比较参数量和计算量。
row.evidence_locator: Sections 2.3 and 3.1; model/ephemeral sparsity and structured pruning
row.source_title: Sparsity in Deep Learning: Pruning and growth for efficient inference and training in neural networks
row.summary_en: Sparsity can arise from pruning, sparse training or input-dependent selection.
row.summary_zh: 稀疏性可来自剪枝，也可来自稀疏训练或输入相关的选择。
row.title_en: Pruning is an operation; sparsity is a property
row.title_zh: 剪枝是方法，稀疏是形态
